_comment: Feature flags. Anything marked 'beta' ships to the booth but stays
invisible until someone switches Beta mode on, so a new idea can be
delivered and tried on the real rig without changing how the lights are
run day to day. Change a stage to 'stable' and push, and it becomes normal
for everyone on the next update. Remove the entry once the feature is
simply part of the app -- unknown keys default to on, so nothing breaks.

someFeature.label: Short name shown in the Beta panel
someFeature.desc: One line on what it does and how finished it is.

quickBlackoutKey.label: Panic key
quickBlackoutKey.desc: Hold Esc twice to black out instantly, without reaching for the mouse.
